params.body:
## What

The garage sheet (`dealer.edit`, `dealer.create`, and the garage's own `ownuser.edit`) used less than half of a wide screen: a 860px card with a two-column form, and the Save button outside the card.

**Layout**
- The card takes the page width, like the settings screen (`max-w-none` over `ui-form-card`).
- The Bedrijf tab is grouped in sections with the existing `ui-section-title` / `ui-form-section` heading: Bedrijf, Adres, Contact, Instellingen, Logo en voorwaarden, module 1, module 2, delegated access. The section names were already in `lang/*/dealer.php` (`section_*`).
- Fields sit in the settings grid `ui-form-grid--4`: one column on a phone, two from 768px, three from 992px, four from 1200px. Street spans two columns with number and addition beside it; postcode, city and country share the next row.
- Carpass, VWE and Nederland Mobiel use the same grid and field component.
- `tabs.blade.php` closed two `div`s it never opened. That closed the card early, which is why Save sat outside it at the far right. Removed.
- No new CSS: `refresh.css` is untouched, everything is existing `ui-` vocabulary plus Tailwind utilities.

**One type scale**
- Every element on the sheet already computed to Poppins; nothing in `x-ui.switch` or `.ui-switch` sets a font family, so the shared component is unchanged. What read as three typefaces was three styles: Bootstrap `control-label` (14px/400, #212529), the switch text (14px/400, ink) and the theme's `h5` for the module lines (16px/300).
- Now: field labels are the `ui-field` label (13px/500), switch texts take that same style, section headings are `ui-section-title` (16px/600). The Spoticar, FlexLease and Nederland Mobiel switches moved from Bootstrap `custom-switch` to `x-ui.switch` (same names, same ids, same hidden 0 + checkbox 1).
- Labels start with a capital through `ucfirst()` on the translation call (Dealergroep, E-mail, Website); no translation changed.
- `x-ui.form-titel` lowers `global.edit`, so the title reads "Dealer aanpassen: 123Upla". That is what the component's own docblock describes ("Relatie aanpassen"), and it applies to every edit title that uses the component (27 views).

**Maximum mileage for biddings**
- The range slider (`ionRangeSlider`, 0 to 1.000.000 km, floating bubble) is replaced by a number field with the suffix "km" (`x-ui.affix`), labelled "Kilometerstand (tot)" with the same `website.label_up_to` label as the mileage filter in the website settings. That filter itself is a select with fixed steps; a garage's stored maximum can be any number, so here it is a typed number rather than a list.
- Field name `max_mileage` and the column are unchanged. Empty is no maximum and is stored as `NULL`, which is what `MailHelper` and `ExportVehicleRepository::getBiddingOfferOverview` already read as "no maximum".
- The slider showed 1.000.000 for an empty value and posted it on every save, so garages that saved their sheet have 1000000 stored. The field shows a stored 1.000.000 or more as empty, and the next save of that sheet stores `NULL`. No migration: rows are only normalised when their sheet is saved. The only difference in outcome is for a bidding vehicle with more than 1.000.000 km, which such a garage would now be offered.
- `DealerRequest` validates `max_mileage` as `nullable|integer|min:0`; before there was no rule.
- Rule R P2-1.7 describes the field and the old slider value.

## Tests

- New `TheBiddingMaximumMileageIsANumberTest` (`@rule P2-1.7`, `B1-2.1`): the field is a number and the slider is gone; `NULL` and 1000000 both show empty; saving empty stores `NULL` and saving 120000 stores 120000; a non-integer or negative value is refused; the creation mail and the bidding offer follow the saved maximum (no maximum and 120.000 receive a 50.000 km car, 40.000 does not).
- Locally green: the dealer and settings feature tests (389), `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `TheThemeOverrulesEverySpacingClassTest`, `QualityRatchetTest`, the rules tests, PHPStan, Pint on the added file.

## Checked on screen

Before and after at 1440, 2000 and 390px, as administrator on another garage and on the garage's own sheet, every tab (Werknemers, Portals, Carpass, VWE, Nederland Mobiel): no horizontal scroll at any width, one column on a phone.
params.title: The garage sheet uses the width: sections, one type scale, and the bidding maximum as a number
